## What's new in 0.19.0

**Models here or by your own Groq key (new).** You choose where the heavy models run: on this computer, as before, or on Groq's servers with a key of your own, quick on any laptop and with nothing to download. Voice typing, recordings and meetings, accurate translation, Check my English, Talk and text editing can each go to Groq; text from screenshots has a switch of its own. Groq has a free plan, enough for a working day; while no card is linked to your Groq account nothing is charged, and past the limit Groq only pauses. The first setup asks; later, Models › Groq has the key, a switch per part and the day's use. A cloud icon marks what Groq did. With no connection, Kryakl uses the model on your computer if it is here, and translation falls back to Fast. The key is encrypted for your Windows account and never goes into a log, a problem report or a backup. Models that Groq makes needless can be removed in one line, Remove the spare.

**The tray menu is Windows' own (new).** A click on the tray icon opens the window, a right click a compact menu: the actions first, then Keyboard layout, Your words, Dictated phrases and, while anything goes to Groq, how much of today's free limit is used.

**Dictation.** On Automatic, a computer with a free graphics card now dictates with Whisper turbo on it, which writes much better than the processor's model; Parakeet on the processor types while other programs fill the card. On a GTX 16xx card Whisper runs in a compact format, about four times quicker there. A pause in the middle of a sentence no longer leaves an ellipsis.

**The typed text.** Voice typing › The typed text: a space after each phrase, a full stop after a single sentence and ё in Russian, each a setting. Sounds at the start and the end of a phrase can be turned on.

**Recordings and meetings.** Windows says when a transcript is ready. A Google Meet call gets people's real names from Meet's own captions. Chrome's extension shows the transcript's progress on its icon after the call.

**Report a problem with dictation.** Report a problem › A problem with what was typed records your next phrases with their sound, for a report; you hear each one and can remove it before sending. It turns itself off after 20 phrases or a day.

**Known issues.** Long English dictation can still drop a sentence. Groq in real use, a live Meet call with names and Teams, Zoom and Whereby in a real call have not all been tried yet. If something breaks, use Report a problem in Kryakl.

## Install and update

**Install:** download `Kryakl-Setup-<version>.exe` and run it. The installer is not signed, so Windows warns: **More info → Run anyway**. Kryakl starts with Windows and lives in the tray.

**Update:** download the new installer from here and run it: it installs over the old version, and your settings, words and downloads stay. Kryakl tells you when a new version is out.

**Updating from 0.17 or older with Chrome's meeting recorder:** once, load the extension from Kryakl's own folder. Open Recordings › Meetings in Chrome in Kryakl: it shows the steps for each Chrome profile, with a button that opens the right Chrome page. After that the extension updates itself.

**Krya is now Kryakl (0.15):** install over Krya as usual. At its first start Kryakl moves Krya's settings, words, models and transcripts into its own folders; nothing downloads again. Quit Krya first if it still runs.
